params.prompt: Create a cinematic insert shot for the same scene shown in reference: Ken, adult Japanese man, seated on taupe sofa in modest Japanese home, wearing the same yellow/magenta/cream/black hoodie. EXTREME CLOSEUP from his eye viewpoint of his dark modern smartphone held upright portrait orientation in BOTH hands. Only hands and sleeve cuffs and phone, no face.
